choice.$description: Corner radius of the checkbox box (BR-10). The radio and the switch are round by shape. TBD-10: "rounded" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

Outline stroke width of the checkbox and the radio (BR-10, BR-13). The switch track keeps Nuxt UI's own border, because its thumb travel is tuned to it. TBD-11: "thick" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

bg.$description: Fill of an unchecked checkbox, radio, or switch track: the pure black page (BR-03). The control is separated from the page by its outline (C-05).

border.$description: Outline color of an unchecked control, and the color of an unchecked switch thumb. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

borderHover.$description: Outline color of an unchecked control while hovered: brand pink (BR-01).

bg.$description: Fill of a checked or indeterminate control: brand pink (BR-01).

border.$description: Outline color of a checked or indeterminate control: brand pink (BR-01).

fg.$description: The check mark, the minus, the radio dot, and the thumb of a checked switch: black on the pink fill (SPEC.md §2.1 derived facts, BR-03).

color.$description: Focus ring color of the checkbox, radio, and switch (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of the checkbox, radio, and switch (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between a control and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of the checkbox, radio, and switch (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
